summary: Nvidia reported blowout earnings after the close yesterday, and that sent technology stocks sharply higher today. The Nasdaq 100, which tracks the biggest tech companies, rose 1.37% while the S&P 500 gained 0.72% to close at 7,730.99. Gold hit 4,663.20, up 1.41%, and silver jumped 3.36%, both signaling that investors are still nervous about inflation and geopolitics even as stocks rallied. Tomorrow brings Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh's first major speech at Jackson Hole, where he is expected to signal whether interest rates will rise, hold, or fall. That speech could move markets sharply.
